statements.proposition: The change is backward compatible and changes neither public APIs nor behavior.
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: Public API appears unchanged: the only source change is in internal code of Tooltip.tsx (a new ref, timeout tracking, mounted checks, effect dependency change); no props, types or exports changed, and the other 9 added files are under benchmark/. But 'behavior' is also claimed: the change removes 'content' from the ResizeObserver effect deps, adds a 'rendered' guard, and delays/cancels timeouts, which alters runtime behaviour (the point of the fix). No test or reproduction was run to settle it, so the behaviour half cannot be settled.
